reviews.x: LOVE this pencil!!! I am a professional brow artist and I'm constantly trying new brow products. I usually stay away from pencils because they can tend to be hard to apply and drag on the brow hair. However, this particular pencil is super easy to apply and glides right on. Best part, it looks really natural and the thick brush at the end keeps everything super smooth. Also, such a great price for a great quality automatic pencil!

I love how natural the color glides on, not too dark, which allows me to go darker. It goes on smooth enough for a pencil and does not look powdery, it’s more of a creamy look but not creamy, just smooth! I wasn’t sure about the universal color, but it matched me so well, and I’ve matched other lighter and darker skin clients to it as well! It would be nice if tip was more pointy but even with round tip I was able to draw in my brows perfectly. I just thin out with a q-tip or wipe off. Color las

I dont know what these people are talking about. This has to be the worst pencil filler I have ever used. The color come out an ashy dark grey when used on the beard. It's not black like the picture. It's literally like a dry crayon. It does not work for atleast. I cant speak for everybody else.

reviews.t: You will love this brow pencil!
reviews.x: Awesome brow pencil. I love the retractable head. The pencil goes on super smooth and easy. It blends in with my pmu and hairs. From what I gather this is a universal color. With maybe an exception of a few tones.

reviews.t: Last all day and color is perfect
reviews.x: Love the color and the burst attached to it . The pencil is very smooth . I wish the tip is finer. The eyebrows look very natural and last all day . I truly recommend it .
[[VIDEOID:9e441bfed0988dd0020832344adc943a]] I received a broken one, I just opened it and the piece flew out.
Love it! Super easy to use, great quality and fills my brows in perfectly. Highly recommend this brow pencil!
[[VIDEOID:66afd9321b2627aeb63fa8b766bc9d3e]] You can’t go wrong with this product for sure !
The flow is so smooth and the precision is on point! This is my go to eyebrow pencil ❤️

Dannis review- (me and the hubby share the same amazon account lolol) Firstly i would like to say the packaging came soo quick! I ordered it and within a day it was here, there is ALOT of product in the twistable brow pencil , and it has the product on one end and a spoolie brush on the other end, it is definitely something i can keep in my purse, or use, now on to the application, the application is a buildable application, it isn’t alot of color all in one which is great since I don’t want bla

The pencil has a basic tip. I rated it 4 stars because it’s not a fine tip where you can be precise and actually draw what looks like hairs. My brows are pretty filled already but this is nice for adding a little something to the edges. Since the tip is so large, I have to kind of just apply some and then use the spoily to blend the color. Be careful when putting the caps back on as the spoily cap is smaller than the pencil cap and I broke off a bit of the pencil on the first use by accidentally

reviews.t: great brow product for a great price!
reviews.x: This brow pencil is a great product! I especially love that the color is more cool toned, which matches my natural brow hair.The color is universal and easy to use..  I was struggling to find a brow pencil that's not too brown or red, so this was perfect. The pencil also glides on very easily and not drying. The tip of the pencil is round but it is not too thin, which makes the application process much quicker. I would love if they had a slant tip! But other than that, no complaint, it's a good

[[VIDEOID:aaa0de202280e68e51318a215b0a5cd]] When It comes Down to Makeup I’m Very Picky So When I Got Offer to Do a Honest Review over the product I took about 3 months just to make sure I like the outcome & I have very sensitive skin & this eye pencil is amazing!! It fits all types of skin You can be a red Head & it still work ! I can honestly say I love this Eye brow pencil!! Everyone always complement me  on my eye brows well ladies this is the magic stick !!

This pencil is amazing! I was initially a bit concerned with color as it can be difficult to color-match my red hair, but this product goes perfectly with my lighter brown/red eyebrows (see photo). It can definitely live up to suiting multiple hair colors - a miracle product. The lines aren’t overly thick to appear drawn on, and the sheerness is perfect to look natural! The tip is easy to use as well. So happy I found this pencil, and use it almost every day.

it’s pretty easy to use and worth it for the $$. personally i found that the blunt tip made it just a little more difficult and i found the color to be darker than i would like and i have dark brown hair. this is supposed to be universal for all hair colors but i’m not sure how it would look on someone with lighter hair bc the color is so dark. and a disclaimer: i personally do not typically use brow pencils anyway. for the money it’s not the worst thing ever

reviews.t: Great universal shade for brow filling
reviews.x: I love this pencil! Its a perfect universal shade for almost all my clients (bright redheads and very blonde blondes excluded). The best feature is that it can wind up or down very easily. Most pencils like this only wind up which can cause breakage and waste. The pencil is firm enough to create hairstrokes and can be easily blended with the brush at the opposite end. I can see how this would be great to fill in men's facial hair too!

I really like that this pencil goes on smooth. It’s a great consistency, making it easy for blending, but solid enough to deliver the look of a few crisp strokes. It also lasts all day and I haven’t noticed any “smudging” or “smearing” throughout the day.  The color is a rich, chocolate brown. I like the color/shade. I’m about a 4 on the Fitzpatrick with warm undertones and this shade matches my microblading almost perfectly.

Beard filler?  It's basically a marker, so when I applied it, it looked like I drew on my face.  If you're already wearing makeup, I imagine this tool would work just fine, but most certainly not to fill in the patches in facial hair :/  When I returned it, the company initially refunded me, then charged me again for supposedly not having returned it -- not cool, people; I most certainly did return it!!

Works as described!!  I was very surprised at how easy this was to fill in my thinning spots.  It doesn't look fake and doesn't rub off.  I even wore a sun hat for a few hours and when I took the hat off, the product was still there instead of a bald spot.  I haven't had to reapply at all during the day or at night.  I really love this stuff.  I definitely recommend this!!

reviews.t: This pencil will fill your eyebrows good.
reviews.x: I love this pencil. I finally fill eye brows with little work. However this pencil its so amazing that it makes me complaint about the length. I bought this pencil on 7/30/20 and today 8/24/20 is finished. Yes the pencil broke a little twice, but come on. Now I need to buy 3 of them to last me like 3 months. I love this pencil so much that I will keep buying monthly.

When o first saw it I thought it was really cute. I love the packaging. The actual product is very nice as well. The only thing I would change is the consistency of it. I would have rather it been a little more creamy and less dry Bc it makes it a little harder to put it on your brow. But overall it’s a really great product and I would purchase again!

This is a great pencil for those who desire a natural looking brow. It’s a shade that blends well with most hair colors and adds just a light touch of shading. I typically go for a really defined brow when I do my makeup so I prefer dark brown/espresso type shades. This will be good for days when I’m not wearing any makeup and just want a light fill.

Loved this product so much. Very easy to use and work with. When I applied pressure to my brows it did not come out super dark at all. I literally colored in my brows with it used the spooley for the beginning of my brows to lighten them up a bit and then cleaned the brows up with concealer. I don't think I'll ever go back to a pomade again.

reviews.t: Perfect brow filler at an awesome price point!
reviews.x: This pencil is great! I have a hard time finding brow fillers that work with my skin tone and hair color (light brown). It dispenses and retracts easily. The spool brush on the other end is perfect for brushing and blending. I enjoy it more than I’ve enjoyed multiple high-end options. I’ll definitely be using this again.

I fill in my brows on a daily basis and I've tried a lot of brands, so I know what I like. With that said I'm really loving the Scalpa FillGod shading pencil.  It's the perfect brow pencil that's not waxy just smooth and brows look beautiful and it stays on for hours.  I love this shading pencil and highly recommend☺️💗

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pencil for gliding on smoothly and being easy to apply.
Many reviewers say the color looks natural and matches a range of hair colors, though a few found it too dark or ashy.
Several reviewers note the tip is not fine or precise enough for detailed hair-like strokes.
A few reviewers mention receiving a broken product or packaging issue.
Some reviewers highlight good value and a large amount of product for the price.
